ns2:course.label: Topics Swahili Lang & Lit I
ns2:course.description: (AFLNG 337) Selected readings from modern Kiswahili authors, with a focus on novels, plays, and basic poetry illustrative of East African cultural issues and advanced level Kiswahili grammar, as well as development of expository writing skills. Same as AFST 405. Prerequisite: SWAH 406.
